coverage.assessment: Three setups are cut while their conclusions remain: 'one per cent' before 'barely half of an average', Marx and Comte's significance, and Harvard's influence before the slipping from fixed principles. Lee's letter and Lowell's encouragement still work.
Pronouns and names stay clear, including Lee's 'He was sober' and 'Lowell had followed the rest.' The Class Day oration now has no physical setting of church, crowd, heat or gowns.
There is little speech. The uncle's 'wanting in enthusiasm' remark and the elderly gentleman's 'perfect self-possession' are each correctly attributed.

The P3 self-debate ('whether in fact it had not ruined him... disappointment apart') is cut, which flattens the concession. The checked facts are kept hedged as written: 'within ten years', the Colonel, the unnamed first scholar, two years in Europe, and Richardson.
The forward glance to his professorship survives, and the Germany section reveals nothing about Berlin's failure. Retrospective irony is intact.
The dash-built self-diminishment ('this--or that--or the other') and the 'judges' sentence are cut. Most double-hyphen periodic sentences and the aphorisms survive.

The two eighteenth-century types argument loses its ironic turn: Yankee self-flattery about the Southerner, then fear for himself. The eighteenth-century framing of the Class Orator ambition is also lost.
Dependencies 0, 1 and 3 are intact at both ends. For dependency 2, the local forward glance survives, but the partner chapter 022 revision cut its 'fault he had found' sentence.

strengths: All eight verbatim passages survive intact, including the water-mark image, the 'insect, or something much lower--a man' reversal, and the mirrors image.
The Lee material keeps the knife-or-pistol danger, Lee's control of his staff, the hedged 'within ten years' retrospect, and the punchline 'The diplomat felt his profession.'
The progression from 'negative force' to calm and self-possession stays distinct and ends on the closing formula.
Continuity facts are correct: Colonel Lee, the unnamed first scholar, two years in Europe with no Civil Law, and Richardson from New Orleans with the friendship formed later.
summary: The revision keeps all eight verbatim passages and every continuity check. It also preserves the main arc of the chapter, from water-mark through negative force to calm and 'Education had not begun.' It adds fresh cuts to the first draft, and several of them remove a hinge in Adams's argument while the conclusion stays: the Yankee's self-flattering verdict on the Southerner before Adams's self-doubt, the 'one per cent of an education' setup, why Marx and Comte matter, the self-ranking that sets up the Class Orator surprise, and Harvard's influence as the cause of his drift toward Concord. Some qualifiers and part of the eighteenth-century motif are also thinned. None of these is a blocker, but each is cheap to restore.
